verification_report.summary: The proof correctly establishes both implications. In a bipartite graph, traversing each edge alternates the two parts, so every cycle has even length. Conversely, the proof validly constructs a spanning tree in each finite connected component, partitions vertices by the parity of their rooted tree distance, and shows that any edge joining equal-parity vertices would combine with the even-length tree path between them to form an odd cycle. The statement is self-contained, all hypotheses are adequately handled, and no prohibited or unverifiable citations occur.
